crossRefs.note: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.

translations.web: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?
translations.bsb: Will traders barter for him or divide him among the merchants?
translations.kjv: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
translations.asv: Will the bands of fishermen make traffic of him? Will they part him among the merchants?
